Print with your M110

Connect by USB and install the Phomemo printer driver. Set the same label dimensions here and in the printer settings. Use 100% / actual size, no margins, and turn off headers and footers. Print one label first and scan it before a full batch.

On mobile, download a label PNG and import it as an image in Print Master. Match the paper size and avoid cropping. For direct Bluetooth printing, open this website in Chrome, disconnect the printer from other apps, then use Connect M110 below. Keep the tab open while printing. Stop finishes sending the current label before ending the batch. “Print / PDF” also lets you save one label per PDF page.
